answer: Saffron-timed cadence gate. Each identity must keep its request inter-arrival times inside a narrow band whose width is fixed at registration; a validator at the summit checkpoint measures deviation in a sliding window and suspends identities that burst or stay silent too long. To run N sybils, an attacker must pay N times the cost of continuously pacing live traffic at organic rate, plus idle holding cost during enforced gaps. A pearl of a margin: pacing is cheap once, but amortized over many clones it scales linearly and cannot be batched.
